text:
GENERATE BURST GS-SBOOK2 -- Run C-9 Phase 2 (Matt R-C9-119): the battle mage's GRIMOIRE held OPEN as a spell-weapon, as a MODEL SHEET for 3D. task_id "GS-SBOOK2".

IMAGE 1 is the grimoire's earlier four-view sheet, CLOSED: oxblood leather covers bound in blackened steel corners, a steel spine band, a steel boss with an ember crystal on the front cover, cream page edges. IMAGE 2 is her battle-mage armour, for the style. IMAGE 3 is a STYLE reference ONLY.
Use image_gen in EDIT mode on IMAGE 1 and deliver ONE 1536x1024 sheet on flat pure #00ff00 showing the SAME BOOK, now OPEN, alone (no hands, no stand, no person), in FOUR orthographic views in ONE row, at ONE common scale, their bottoms on one ground line, nothing overlapping. THE OPEN GRIMOIRE: the two covers and the page block splayed wide, about 155 degrees between the covers (almost flat, a shallow V), each cover about 26 cm tall and 20 cm wide, the whole open book about 42 cm across; the pages thick and cream, slightly curved up from the spine; both open pages painted with dark-ink SPELL GLYPHS, circles and runes, a few of them in ember red with a FAINT warm glow; one cloth ribbon marker. Its covers and steel fittings are IMAGE 1's.
THE FOUR VIEWS, the book standing upright on its bottom edge with its SPINE VERTICAL at the centre:
FIRST (left): the OPEN PAGES face-on, the spine vertical in the middle, both pages fully visible, about 42 cm wide;
SECOND: turned 90 degrees -- the book EDGE-ON from its left side: the shallow V of the open covers seen from the side, narrow;
THIRD: turned 180 degrees -- the OUTSIDE of both covers face-on, the steel spine band vertical in the middle;
FOURTH (right): turned 270 degrees -- edge-on from its right side, the mirror of the second.
Paint in IMAGE 3's hand (dark ink line, transparent washes, hatching), matched to IMAGE 2. Soft even light, only the ember crystal glows faintly, no cast shadows, no ground, no text, no labels.
BACKGROUND: flat pure #00ff00. If the image model returns a darker or gradient background anyway, still deliver the image.

Two image_gen EDIT calls: variants a and b. NO RETRIES: if a variant has a fault, deliver it anyway and NAME it in concerns -- the book closed or opened less than about 130 degrees, blank pages, the covers different from IMAGE 1, a view missing, the object differing between views, a hand or person appearing, or text appearing. Copy outputs to out/GS-SBOOK2_a.png and out/GS-SBOOK2_b.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: receipt task_id "GS-SBOOK2"; images = the files with prompt, references (role + path) and elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: IMAGE 1 -- the grimoire's earlier closed sheet to EDIT (GS-SBOOK_a): the same book, open
IMAGE 2 -- her battle-mage set (GS-SHOOD, Matt's pick): the steel, the gold borders and the ember red to match
IMAGE 3 -- STYLE reference ONLY (Matt-supplied, R-C9-69): the hand; never its character, costume, staff or pose
